narrative: Daniel's third book open on the board, his own copy, beside the shut chronicle. No second volume. No face. The same open book. A line in the margin of his tables, newly wet. The chair has not moved toward the door. The third book closed on his own boards. Paul's is not in the room. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote that the errand was not this week, and stayed at the board.

entities.name: Daniel's third book
entities.context: Shown on book in Daniel, and not Paul's
